body:
It was one boring day at school and I came home and decided to chill. I read about ginger so I tried a 1/2 tsp of some stirred with milk. I didn't feel one thing so I took 1 1/2 tsps and drank it. This one was hard to sip down but I got it. Instantly I felt relaxed and calm. I put on some ICP and sat down.  I felt a sensation start in my forearm and move across my body. I stood up and felt I was flying. Within 10 minutes it was over. It feels good but upset my stomach a bit.
